Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Economy | National Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 opens today at Ghud Park, Accra Mall Source : Joy Business 13 November 2026 5:48am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 opens today at the GHUD Park, Accra Mall, bringing together businesses and consumers for a three-day exhibition of Ghanaian products and services.
The fair, powered by JoyPrime, will run from November 13 to 15, 2026, providing a platform for businesses to showcase their products, connect with potential customers and explore new market opportunities.
The exhibition will feature a wide range of products and services across fashion, beauty, food, technology, home essentials, lifestyle and other sectors.
Visitors will have the opportunity to discover new brands, shop for locally made products, enjoy special deals and interact directly with businesses participating in the fair.
For exhibitors, the event offers an opportunity to increase brand visibility, attract new customers, drive sales and build lasting business relationships.
Organisers say the fair is designed to create an engaging marketplace where businesses can promote their offerings while consumers access a variety of products and services under one roof.
Business owners and prospective exhibitors interested in securing space can contact Diana on 055 023 8383 or Desmond on 024 454 6983 for further information.
The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 runs from November 13 to 15 at the GHUD Park, Accra Mall.
